_: metallica_spike on VPW's 'Metallica Premium Monsters (Stern 2013)' 2.0.2: the 2013
SAM playfield (ROM mtl_180h) that Stern's Metallica Remastered (Spike 2) reuses.
This map is what patch_metallica_spike.py applies to its script, and what
here the SAM ROM's own solenoid number so the table's SolCallback lines stand.
The table keeps its SAM switch numbers in the computed paths (drop and standup
target helpers pass `Switchid mod 100`); `switch_rewrite` serves those, and the
patcher rewrites every literal number to 1000+id.
0.0066*x + 0.301*y + 44.5), fitted on 17 switches, worst residual 13 drawing px.
title: metallica_spike

game_on._: a synthetic solenoid for core.vbs's GameOnSolenoid (UseSolenoids=2, fast flips): ON while the flipper coils' board rules are armed

switch_rewrite._: the table's SAM number -> Spike 2 switch id (0 = no Spike 2 switch: the edge is dropped)

switch_notes._: how each SAM number was matched (object, position in drawing px, Spike 2 name); GUESS = check on the machine
switch_notes.16: Start (the table's own press is removed; PADSPIKE2.vbs presses 1036)
switch_notes.18-21: physical trough, sw21 at the eject end: TROUGH 4..1 (the table holds 4 balls; TROUGH 5, 6, JAM stay open)
switch_notes.22: pulsed by SolTrough on every release (SAM trough eject); no Spike 2 switch
switch_notes.23: sw23 trigger at the shooter lane's foot (278,628) SHOOTER LANE
switch_notes.24/25/28/29: lane triggers: LEFT OUTLANE, LEFT RETURN LANE-LEFT, RIGHT RETURN LANE, RIGHT OUTLANE
switch_notes.30/31/32: Bumper2b LEFT POP, Bumper1b RIGHT POP, Bumper3b BOTTOM POP
switch_notes.33/34: the grave marker cross's timers: 33 at the bottom (GRAVE MARKER DN), 34 at the top (GRAVE MARKER UP)
switch_notes.38/39: LSpinner LT LOOP SPINNER, RSpinner RT LOOP SPINNER
switch_notes.43/46: orbit triggers LEFT LOOP / RIGHT LOOP
switch_notes.47/50: ramp exit gates sw47g RT RAMP EXIT OPTO, sw50g LT RAMP EXIT OPTO
switch_notes.52: sw52 trigger at the grave marker magnet (71,168) GRAVE MARKER OPTO
switch_notes.55: GUESS: JawLatch wall hit (ball against the closed jaw) -> SNAKE LATCH
switch_notes.56: GUESS: made while the jaw is open (SolSnakeJaw sets it, SnakeJawLatch clears it) -> SNAKE JAW OPEN
switch_notes.57-59: coffin lock triggers sw57..59: the Spike 2 coffin switches are the Mag Sensor node's (node 10, ids 88-91 / 101-104, unnamed) - not mapped
switch_notes.60-62: drop targets BOT / MID / TOP; the table reports a RAISED target as made (SAM polarity)
switch_notes.63/64: coffin magnet ball detect / coffin down: the SAM magnet processor board; no Spike 2 counterpart

switch_holds._: switches held while a ball sits somewhere (the table's physical trough serves them)

_: Spike 2 coil [node, index] -> the SMALL number the table script sees it as: the SAM
solenoid number the table's SolCallback already uses, except the flippers, which take
core.vbs's Consts (sLRFlipper 46, sLLFlipper 48). Coil groups -> nodes from
group_node.txt; group 9 (the Mag Sensor board, node 10 in node_ident.txt) has no node
there because the census skipped that board, so its two coils are GUESS.
`dof`: the number DOF knows a coil by (the ROM's, mtl_180h's DOF config), where the
key is not it - the flippers, SAM solenoids 15 and 16 (PAD-879).

lamps._: table light -> Spike 2 LEDs [node, index] (several = an RGB insert: lit when any is). `sub` = a flasher: the LED drives that SolModCallback sub (level 0/1) instead of a light. GUESS = check on the machine
